Exceptional commercial acumen, a strong grasp of economics and global market dynamics, combined with the energy of five people (at least) make Charles a formidable operator. With no hesitation, I highly recommend Charles Handley to candidates and businesses alike.”

Intelligence for both sides of the hire

Talent markets behave like asset markets. Capital flows, rate cycles and deal activity move demand for people long before it shows up in hiring plans. We track those signals so clients can set talent strategy before conditions materialise, not after.

About us

Dalton Handley is an executive search and recruitment firm, established in Sydney in 2013.

We recruit business development, marketing, client, communications, origination, distribution and investor relations roles, permanent and contract, in two sectors: professional services firms and investment funds.

Dalton Handley forms part of a decade long international alliance: a partner in Australia and three associate partners in the United Kingdom and Hong Kong, each a business and market leader in their own market, enabling us to run multijurisdictional searches and provide clients with an international talent pool.

An alliance partnership spanning Australia, Asia and the United Kingdom, offering you access to international talent and opportunities.

Your consultant in Australia: Charles Handley, Partner.

Charles advises professional services and growth businesses on the people decisions that drive revenue: who leads growth, how commercial functions are structured, and whether the team in place can deliver the plan.

As private capital moves into accounting, advisory, engineering and consulting, turning a partner led model into a scalable revenue engine has become the central challenge. Charles has worked on it for twenty years, grounded in how partnerships win, price and retain work.

He has placed hundreds of work winning professionals into firms including HSF Kramer, Allens, Gilbert + Tobin, Mallesons, Freshfields, Linklaters, A&O Shearman, Deloitte, KPMG, PwC and BCG, and the teams he has built have supported more than $3 billion in revenue growth. Throughout his career, his work has also spanned JP Morgan, Fidelity, ANZ Institutional Bank, CBA, Westpac, Lendlease, CBRE and JLL.

He began in front office investment banking search in London, then joined Ambition’s professional services desk. At Ampersand he established and grew the national Professional Services practice and managed the Sydney Financial Services desk. He was the firm’s highest performing consultant when he left to found Dalton Handley in 2013.

Charles reads the capital cycle to anticipate hiring demand before it appears. For firms owned by private capital, or preparing for it, that means a clearer view of commercial capability in diligence, advice on structure as teams integrate or scale, and early sight of where talent is about to become scarce or expensive. His work covers restructuring, remuneration and recruitment, tied to margin and durable revenue, not headcount.

He holds an Economics degree from University College London and is studying towards the CAIA. He is fluent in AI and the data infrastructure behind efficient client and growth functions, and has worked closely with the firm’s Associate International Alliance Partners in London and Hong Kong on cross border mandates for more than a decade.

For talent

Your next move, handled with care.

Business Development · Clients · Marketing · Origination · Distribution · Investor Relations

Trusted counsel first. The search follows.

We have advised many of the same people for more than a decade, through promotions, moves and returns to the market, and a good number of them are now our clients. The relationship is the point. The role is one chapter of it.

So we start with counsel: where the market is heading, what you are worth, which firms and funds are building, and whether the move in front of you is the right one. If it is not, we will tell you. When it is, we coach you through every stage, from the first briefing to the final conversation, and your details are never sent to a firm or fund without your agreement.

Current and upcoming opportunities.

Many of our roles are confidential and never advertised. Contact us to explore your options.
